mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doumail (from_user_id, to_user_id, chat_msg, chat_time, status, `read`) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, NOW(), 0, 0)
INSERT INTO doumail (from_user_id, to_user_id, chat_msg, chat_time, status, `read`) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, NOW(), 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT d.doumail_id, d.from_user_id, d.to_user_id, d.chat_msg, d.chat_time, d.status, d.`read`, u1.nickname as from_user_nick, u1.portrait as from_user_img, u2.nickname as to_user_nick, u2.portrait as to_user_img FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user u1 ON d.from_user_id = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON d.to_user_id = u2.user_id WHERE (d.from_user_id = #{userId} AND d.to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND d.status != 1) OR (d.from_user_id = #{toUserId} AND d.to_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 2) ORDER BY d.chat_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doumail WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status != 1) OR (from_user_id = #{toUserId} AND to_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2)

SELECT d.doumail_id, d.from_user_id, d.to_user_id, d.chat_msg, d.chat_time, d.`read`, CASE WHEN d.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN u2.nickname ELSE u1.nickname END as contact_nick, CASE WHEN d.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN u2.portrait ELSE u1.portrait END as contact_img, CASE WHEN d.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN d.to_user_id ELSE d.from_user_id END as contact_id FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user u1 ON d.from_user_id = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON d.to_user_id = u2.user_id WHERE (d.from_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 1) OR (d.to_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 2) ORDER BY d.chat_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE doumail SET `read` = 1 WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND `read` = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doumail WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND `read` = 0 AND status != 2

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END) FROM doumail WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 1) OR (to_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doumail WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND status != 1) OR (from_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND to_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2)

SELECT d.* FROM doumail d INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(doumail_id) as max_id FROM doumail WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 1) OR (to_user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2) GROUP BY CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END ) latest ON d.doumail_id = latest.max_id ORDER BY d.chat_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT d.doumail_id, d.from_user_id, d.to_user_id, d.chat_msg, d.chat_time, d.status, d.`read` FROM doumail d WHERE (d.from_user_id = #{userId} AND d.to_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND d.status != 1) OR (d.from_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND d.to_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 2) ORDER BY d.chat_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
